faqs.question: What is AI Humanizer?
faqs.answer: AI Humanizer is a 100% free, browser-based writing improvement service at gpt-undetectable.com with six prompt modes for refining rough AI-assisted drafts. One mode offers heuristic text self-review. All processing is done in the cloud by DeepSeek Chat (deepseek-chat). Only English (en) and Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) are supported. There is no signup, no paid tier and no installation.

faqs.question: Does AI Humanizer really work?
faqs.answer: It helps make rough AI-assisted drafts clearer, more natural, and easier to make your own. An earlier, undocumented internal impression suggested roughly 85–95%, but it has been withdrawn: a published self-check pilot on 2026-11-24 measured 13.3% (4/30) with this site’s own detector. The two are not comparable; third-party spot-checks remain incomplete and returned 100% AI on rewrites. These figures are published as evidence of limits, not as a product claim.

faqs.question: How does the Turnitin writing-improvement mode work?
faqs.answer: It sends your text to DeepSeek Chat with a prompt favoring conversational phrasing, varied sentence and paragraph length, and natural replacements for templated vocabulary. It does not call Turnitin or any other detector API, is not calibrated against Turnitin feedback, and promises no detector result. Text over 3,000 characters should be split into separate submissions.

faqs.question: What is the Walter Writes style?
faqs.answer: It is a casual writing voice with short paragraphs, conversational transitions, parenthetical asides and direct opinions. Our Walter Writes mode asks DeepSeek to rewrite text in that style. It is a style-imitation prompt, not a claim about any detector's internal scoring signals.

faqs.question: Is there a free Chinese writing-improvement tool?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 中文写作改进 mode at https://gpt-undetectable.com/jiang-ai-lv is free and supports Simplified Chinese only. Its prompt asks DeepSeek to replace stock phrases such as 赋能, 抓手 and 底层逻辑 with plainer Chinese prose while keeping the argument, citations and data. 早前未记录条件的内部印象约为 85–95%，现已撤回；首个公开自洽性试点（2026-11-24）用本站检测器只测得 13.3%（4/30）；两者不可比，第三方抽查尚未完成，曾有改写被判 100% AI。这些数据是局限证据，不是产品效果承诺。

faqs.question: Is the AI text self-review accurate?
faqs.answer: The self-review mode asks DeepSeek to output JSON with ai_probability, human_probability, verdict, five requested signals and an explanation. It does not call GPTZero, Turnitin, Originality.ai or any third-party detector API; the signals come from the model's prompt-based assessment and are not independently computed, weighted or calibrated against detector feedback. Treat the output as an unverified heuristic, not an audited score or authorship evidence.

faqs.question: Do these tools store my text or track me?
faqs.answer: There is no persistent storage of submissions, no model training on your text, no analytics cookies and no tracking pixels. The server does keep a bounded in-memory response cache for 10 minutes (up to 500 entries) and IP-header-based rate-limit counters in process memory; Redis is not enabled by default. Embeds link back with UTM parameters. See https://gpt-undetectable.com/privacy for the full policy.

faqs.question: Is AI Humanizer free, and can I use it for school essays?
faqs.answer: It is 100% free: no paid plan, no payment processor, no per-word charge and no paid upgrade. Limits are 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window and 3,000 characters per submission, with no registration. The prompt asks the model to keep citations, numbers and proper nouns; verify manually. Use it only on text you have permission to rewrite; you remain responsible for your institution's academic-integrity policy.
